# fider_oauth_config (Resource)

Manages a custom OAuth2 provider configuration for a Fider tenant. This resource requires an admin API key for the specific tenant.

> **Note:** Fider has no delete API for custom OAuth configs. On `terraform destroy`, the config is disabled (status=1) rather than removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fider_oauth_config" "keycloak" {
  provider_name = "keycloak"
  display_name  = "Keycloak"

  client_id     = "fider"
  client_secret = var.keycloak_client_secret

  authorize_url = "https://keycloak.example.com/realms/myrealm/protocol/openid-connect/auth"
  token_url     = "https://keycloak.example.com/realms/myrealm/protocol/openid-connect/token"
  profile_url   = "https://keycloak.example.com/realms/myrealm/protocol/openid-connect/userinfo"
  scope         = "openid profile email"

  json_user_id_path    = "sub"
  json_user_name_path  = "name"
  json_user_email_path = "email"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorize_url` (String) OAuth2 authorization endpoint URL.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown on the login button (max 50 characters).
- `json_user_id_path` (String) JSONPath expression to extract the user ID from the profile response (e.g. `sub`).
- `provider_name` (String) Unique provider slug. Used as the identifier and in the OAuth callback URL (`/oauth/<provider_name>/callback`). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `scope` (String) Space-separated OAuth2 scopes to request (e.g. `openid profile email`).
- `token_url` (String) OAuth2 token endpoint URL.

### Optional

- `allowed_roles` (String) Comma-separated list of roles allowed to sign in via this provider.
- `is_trusted` (Boolean) When `true`, users from this provider are automatically trusted. Defaults to `false`.
- `json_user_email_path` (String) JSONPath expression to extract the user email (e.g. `email`).
- `json_user_name_path` (String) JSONPath expression to extract the user display name (e.g. `name`).
- `json_user_roles_path` (String) JSONPath expression to extract roles for role-based access control.
- `profile_url` (String) URL to fetch the user profile (userinfo endpoint). Optional.
- `status` (Number) Provider status. `1` = disabled, `2` = enabled. Defaults to `2`.
